# Document Notes: Chapters 1-40

## Setting and Time
- **Seasons**: Spring (Year 1, Chapter 1); Summer (Year 1, Chapter 2); Autumn (Year 1, Chapter 3); Winter (Year 1, Chapter 4); Spring (Year 2, Chapter 5); Summer (Year 2, Chapter 6); Autumn (Year 2, Chapter 7); Winter (Year 2, Chapter 8); Spring (Year 3, Chapter 9); Summer (Year 3, Chapter 10); Autumn (Year 3, Chapter 11); Winter (Year 3, Chapter 12); Spring (Year 4, Chapter 13); Summer (Year 4, Chapter 14); Autumn (Year 4, Chapter 15); Winter (Year 4, Chapter 16); Spring (Year 5, Chapter 17); Summer (Year 5, Chapter 18); Autumn (Year 5, Chapter 19); Winter (Year 5, Chapter 20); Spring (Year 6, Chapter 21); Summer (Year 6, Chapter 22); Autumn (Year 6, Chapter 23); Winter (Year 6, Chapter 24); Spring (Year 7, Chapter 25); Summer (Year 7, Chapter 26); Autumn (Year 7, Chapter 27); Winter (Year 7, Chapter 28); Spring (Year 8, Chapter 29); Summer (Year 8, Chapter 30); Autumn (Year 8, Chapter 31); Winter (Year 8, Chapter 32); Spring (Year 9, Chapter 33); Summer (Year 9, Chapter 34); Autumn (Year 9, Chapter 35); Winter (Year 9, Chapter 36); Spring (Year 10, Chapter 37); Summer (Year 10, Chapter 38); Autumn (Year 10, Chapter 39); Winter (Year 10, Chapter 40)

## The Marroway Household
**Location**: Ravenhaven (originally); Wilholt (winter, Year 4+); Fenmere (Malis, winter, Year 10)

**Parents**:
- Taten Marroway (father): Works as ferryman; born in Mireholt; possesses bone lantern; quit Ravenhaven (summer, Year 6); sorted old letters at Wilholt (summer, Year 8); married Tawyn Haskoway at Wilholt (summer, Year 10); couple lives in Wilholt
- Jora Marroway (mother): Works as cooper; counted coins short (winter, Year 4); went to Wilholt (summer, Year 6); talked with Nybin Wexwood (winter, Year 6); received brass flute from Voena Dornick (winter, Year 6); sent brass flute by carrier to youngest son of Elrald Wexwood (summer, Year 8); confided to by youngest son of Nyzek Dornick about forged deed (winter, Year 8); died of winter fever at Wilholt (autumn, Year 35)

**Children**:
1. Malis Marroway (eldest daughter): Weaver; born at Mireholt; married Lubin Stenoway; lived Larkhaven, Elmgate, Mireford, Salford; received letter from Lubin revealing second cellar at Mirecombe abbey (Chapter 12); won jade compass from Jossa at cards fairly (autumn, Year 5); confided to Jossa about second cellar (winter, Year 5); told Zalis about second cellar (spring, Year 6); revealed in letter to Kabin about second cellar (spring, Year 7, letter burned); moved to Salford (summer, Year 7); gave jade compass to Isdette (autumn, Year 7); told by Isdette that bridge toll skimmed (spring, Year 8); followed Lubin to Dunton (summer, Year 8); quit Dunton for good with Lubin, took lodgings in Fenmere (winter, Year 10)

2. Zalis Marroway (daughter): Tanner; married Ribin Wexwood; gave birth to Ferine (autumn, Year 2); went to Wilholt (winter, Year 4); gave birth to Nybin (spring, Year 6); moved to Mireford (spring, Year 6); became shepherd; told by Malis about second cellar (spring, Year 6); moved to Dunton (winter, Year 7); received promise from Ribin to plant orchard above Braegate (spring, Year 8); remarked river is up again in Dunton (winter, Year 10)

3. Jolan Marroway (son): Fisher; married Thilis Haskoway at Ravenhaven (summer, Year 2); bought ribbon, regretted it (winter, Year 4); counted coins short (spring, Year 5); married Illia in chapel at Elmgate (autumn, Year 4); went to Braegate (winter, Year 4); laughed at story (winter, Year 5); fathered Veswyn Marroway with Thilis (summer, Year 10); family lives in Torton (summer, Year 10)

## The Haskoway Household
**Location**: Larkholt (originally); Larkmere (summer, Year 3); Wilcombe/various locations for children; Torton (summer, Year 10 for Thilis/Veswyn); Wilcombe (Dabin/Ormira); Mireford (Ormira, winter, Year 10)

**Parents**:
- Jovus Haskoway (father): Shepherd; settled in Larkmere (summer, Year 3); gave bone seal to Quiet Jovus (autumn, Year 5); received bone seal from Kara (summer, Year 6); gave promise to Pemira to rebuild fallen wall at Wilcombe (spring, Year 8); married Jossa Wexwood at Elmgate (spring, Year 8); died of old age at Elmgate (winter, Year 8)
- Kara Haskoway (mother): Herbalist; born at Salford; went to Larkmere (summer, Year 3); gave promise to Garald to teach children of Mirecombe (autumn, Year 4); never kept promise (spring, Year 5); complained of aching back (winter, Year 4); read almanac aloud, mispronouncing saints (spring, Year 5); received bone seal from Jovus (summer, Year 6); died of old age at Larkmere (autumn, Year 6)

**Children**:
1. Rodette Haskoway (eldest daughter): Tanner; married Maric Ashmere; lived Mireholt, Salford; swore to Ellia to repair chapel roof, never kept (Chapter 2); gave birth to Aewyn (autumn, Year 1); left Mireholt (spring, Year 2); apprenticed anew as tanner (summer, Year 5); gave birth to Nezek (autumn, Year 6); family in Salford

2. Dabin Haskoway (son): Mason; born at Salford; quit Larkholt, took lodgings in Mireford (autumn, Year 3); wed Red Ormira at Braegate (autumn, Year 3); moved to Wilcombe with Ormira (spring, Year 4); bought ribbon, regretted it (summer, Year 6); fathered Tawyn with Ormira; family in Wilcombe (spring, Year 7); gave solemn promise to Ordette Brackett to rebuild fallen wall at Mireholt (autumn, Year 10); fathered Vesdan Haskoway with Ormira; family in Mireford (winter, Year 10)

3. Thilis Haskoway (daughter): Mason; mended torn sleeve (spring, Year 2); married Jolan Marroway at Ravenhaven (summer, Year 2); moved to Larkmere (summer, Year 4); found work in Braegate (winter, Year 4); swore to Jolan to pay old debt owed to Ashmere family (winter, Year 5); broke faith with Jolan—promised work never begun (autumn, Year 10); walked long way round to avoid muddy square (autumn, Year 10); gave birth to daughter Veswyn Marroway (summer, Year 10); family lives in Torton (summer, Year 10)

4. Pemira Haskoway (daughter): See Pemira Velloway below

**Family legacy**: Toll bridge at Wilcombe belongs to Haskoway family; only those born Haskoway or married to one allowed to cross

## The Dornick Household
**Location**: Wilholt (originally); Wilcombe (Chapter 9); Mirehaven (Chapter 12); Mireford (various); Elmgate (autumn, Year 7+); Mirecombe (Kabin/Vonelle, summer, Year 34+)

**Parents**:
- Nyzek Dornick (father): Called "Red Nyzek"; swore to Voena to rebuild fallen wall at Wilcombe (Chapter 2); revealed in letter that harbor master of Mireford takes bribes (Chapter 5); complained of salt prices (Chapter 7); died of winter fever at Wilholt (winter, Year 3); youngest son confided to Jora that deed to Mirecombe pastures was forged (winter, Year 8)
- Illia Dornick (mother): Mason; born in Mirehaven; told by Elrald that Fellwood mill ledger rewritten after flood (Chapter 2); told by Tall Vesra same (Chapter 9); quit Mireholt (autumn, Year 4); hummed childhood tune (autumn, Year 4); confided to Vesra about rewritten ledger (autumn, Year 4); married Jolan Wexwood at Elmgate (autumn, Year 4); revealed in letter that deed forged (autumn, Year 6, letter burned); died of festered wound at Elmgate (autumn, Year 7)

**Children**:
1. Karald Dornick (eldest son): Chandler; burned letter from Nyzek (Chapter 5); moved to Elmgate (summer, Year 2); married Pemira Velloway at Larkholt (winter, Year 2); died of festered wound (winter, Year 3); buried at Larkholt

2. Kabin Dornick (son): Cooper, called "Old Kabin"; married Vonelle Fellwood at Wilholt (autumn, Year 2); moved to Wilcombe (spring, Year 3); had son Orten (winter, Year 3); moved to Mirehaven (winter, Year 3); talked of going to Elmgate, stayed (spring, Year 4); gave birth to Zazek (winter, Year 5); told by Vonelle deed forged; they quarreled; Vonelle quit for Mireford (winter, Year 6); followed her (winter, Year 6); told by Ribin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 7); burned letter from Malis (spring, Year 7); moved to Elmgate (autumn, Year 7); quit Elmgate, returned to Mireford (autumn, Year 8); Vonelle went along (autumn, Year 8); found work in Mirecombe, moved there with Vonelle (summer, Year 34); revealed in letter that old abbey at Mirecombe hides second cellar (autumn, Year 10, letter burned)

3. Voena Dornick (daughter): Mason; possesses brass flute; won brass flute from Lunar at cards fairly (Chapter 11); Lunar pressed it back (Chapter 11); fell asleep in chair (summer, Year 5; autumn, Year 5); argued over oat sack price (spring, Year 6); quit Wilholt, took lodgings in Mirecombe (winter, Year 6); pressed brass flute into Jora's hands (winter, Year 6); married Orten Dornick at Mirecombe (summer, Year 7); won amber flute from youngest daughter of Yedette Fellwood at cards fairly, kept it (autumn, Year 10); hummed childhood tune while scrubbing step (autumn, Year 10); talked with Ellia Ashmere of nothing much—weather, harvest, lame horse (autumn, Year 10)

## The Velloway Household
**Location**: Larkholt (originally); Mireholt (spring, Year 2); Salford (winter, Year 36); Ravenhaven (Pemira/Dabin, winter, Year 10); Fenmere (Malis, winter, Year 10)

**Parents**:
- Molan Velloway (father): Brewer; went to Mireholt (spring, Year 2); fell asleep in chair (winter, Year 2); confided to by Isbin about bridge toll skimming (autumn, Year 4); gave promise to Ordette to carry sealed letter to Salford (winter, Year 7); died of old age at Mireholt (spring, Year 33)
- Colis Velloway (mother): Glazier; born at Wilholt; went to Mireholt (spring, Year 2); burned letter from Isbin about bridge toll (autumn, Year 6); dead of fall from mill loft at Mireholt (winter, Year 8)

**Children**:
1. Katho Velloway (eldest son): Smith; married Aera Stenoway; lived Larkholt; went to Braegate (winter, Year 2); died of old age at Braegate (winter, Year 3)

2. Ulena Velloway (daughter): Cooper; married Red Zaten at Larkholt (autumn, Year 2); fell asleep in chair (winter, Year 2); swore to Karald to rebuild fallen wall at Mireholt (winter, Year 2); dead of fall from mill loft at Larkholt (summer, Year 4)

3. Pemira Velloway (daughter): Chandler; born at Wilcombe; married Karald Dornick at Larkholt (winter, Year 2); lived Larkholt; received bone seal from Pewyn (spring, Year 3); wed Dabin Wexson at Larkmere (autumn, Year 3); gave bone seal to Quiet Jovus (autumn, Year 5); gave birth to Febin with Dabin (spring, Year 7); family in Larkmere (spring, Year 8); gave promise to Jovus to rebuild fallen wall at Wilcombe (spring, Year 8); left Larkmere, settled in Salford (winter, Year 36); Dabin followed within the month; moved to Ravenhaven (winter, Year 10)

## The Ashmere Household
**Location**: Mireholt (originally); Mirecombe (autumn, Year 4); various locations for children; Mireford (Vesra/Lunar, spring, Year 33+)

**Parents**:
- Pemor Ashmere (father): Born at Mireholt; married Ellia; apprenticed anew as herbalist (summer, Year 1); told Pedan he looked tired (spring, Year 2); died of long wasting sickness at Mireholt (spring, Year 3); youngest son gave Rodette promise to pay old debt owed to Marroway family (Chapter 12)
- Ellia Ashmere (mother): Smith; born in Mireford; counted coins short (Chapter 3); pressed amber flute into Elra's hands (Chapter 10); quit Mireholt (autumn, Year 4); married Isdan Wexson at Mireholt (winter, Year 3); couple lives in Mireholt; revealed in letter that deed forged (autumn, Year 6, letter burned); won amber flute from Vonelle Fellwood at cards fairly (autumn, Year 35); gave Orten solemn promise to plant orchard on slope above Fenmere (autumn, Year 10); talked with Voena Dornick of nothing much—weather, harvest, lame horse (autumn, Year 10)

**Children**:
1. Vesra Ashmere (eldest daughter): Shepherd, called "Tall Vesra"; married Lunar Brackett; lived Torton, Mirecombe, Wilholt, Larkholt, Mireford; revealed in letter about chest of silver buried at Wilcombe (Chapter 6, letter burned); moved to Mirecombe (summer, Year 2); went to Wilholt (winter, Year 2); talked of going to Ravenhaven, stayed (spring, Year 3); told Illia deed forged (spring, Year 3); confided to by Illia about rewritten ledger (autumn, Year 4); rode out of Wilholt; by next market day in Larkholt (summer, Year 5); followed Lunar (autumn, Year 5); gave birth to Ilra at Larkholt (spring, Year 6); family in Larkholt; swore to Lunar to plant orchard above Mireford (summer, Year 7); told Lunar about rewritten ledger (summer, Year 8); gave up being shepherd, took work as brewer (summer, Year 34); followed Lunar to Mireford within the month (spring, Year 33); gave birth to daughter Aevie Brackett; family lives in Mireford (autumn, Year 10); confided to Ordette that deed to Mirecombe pastures was forged (autumn, Year 10); told Ormira Brackett that deed forged (autumn, Year 10); talked with Lunar of nothing much—weather, harvest, lame horse (autumn, Year 10)

2. Pedan Ashmere (son): Possesses amber flute; gave it to Elra (Chapter 3); told by Pemor he looked tired (spring, Year 2); wed Aera Stenoway at Braegate (spring, Year 4); swore to Aera to plant orchard above Torton (Chapter 13); found work in Elmgate (spring, Year 5); sent jade map by carrier to Zamor via Aera (summer, Year 6); found work in Ravenhaven (autumn, Year 7); swore to Jolan Wexwood to plant orchard above Wilholt (spring, Year 8); gave solemn promise to only daughter of Orrald Stenoway to plant orchard on slope above Fenmere (spring, Year 10)

3. Elra Ashmere (daughter): Weaver; born in Larkmere; possesses iron ledger; bought ribbon, regretted it (Chapter 2); received amber flute from Pedan (Chapter 3); married Isbin Brackett at Mireholt (spring, Year 2); couple lives in Mireholt; counted coins short (Chapter 10); pressed amber flute into Ellia's hands (Chapter 10); gave birth to Ordette (spring, Year 4); gave birth to Wedette (winter, Year 4); sent parcel with iron ledger to Garald (autumn, Year 4); apprenticed anew as smith (spring, Year 33); pressed iron ledger into hands of Garald Fellwood, would take nothing for it (winter, Year 36)

4. Maric Ashmere (son): Smith, called "Lame Maric"; married Rodette Haskoway; lived Mireholt, Salford; possesses silver ring; father to Aewyn; went to Salford (spring, Year 2); finished promise to pay old debt to Marroway family (spring, Year 4); swore to Orrald to plant orchard above Dunton (winter, Year 4); counted coins short (summer, Year 5); received silver ring from Pewyn (winter, Year 4); finished promise to Orrald (autumn, Year 6); fathered Nezek (autumn, Year 6); family in Salford; complained of aching back (summer, Year 8)

## The Wexwood Household
**Location**: Wilholt (originally); Mireford (Chapter 3); Elmgate (winter, Year 7); Elmgate (spring, Year 8+)

**Parents**:
- Elrald Wexwood (father): Possessed jade compass and jade ledger; knew Fellwood mill ledger rewritten; told Illia (Chapter 2); swore to Zaten to plant orchard above Mirehaven (Chapter 2); found work in Mireford (Chapter 3); confided to Jossa about ledger (Chapter 4); walked long way to avoid muddy square (Chapter 4); hummed childhood tune (Chapter 4); pressed jade compass into Jossa's hands (winter, Year 3); confided to Lubin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 5, late one night); died of kick from cart horse at Mireford (summer, Year 5); jade compass and ledger handed to Jossa among his things
- Jossa Wexwood (mother): Weaver; followed Elrald to Mireford (Chapter 3); confided to by Elrald (Chapter 4); watched clouds, predicted rain wrongly (Chapter 4); talked of going to Larkmere, stayed (Chapter 4); started rumor Zalis Marroway was dead of plague (Chapter 4); whispered Ormira secretly married Eltho (summer, Year 3, unconfirmed); pressed jade compass into Elrald's hands (winter, Year 3); talked with Lubin of nothing much (summer, Year 5); received jade compass and ledger from Elrald's things (Chapter 18); had jade compass won from by Malis at cards fairly (autumn, Year 5); confided to by Malis about second cellar (winter, Year 5); swore to Lubin to repair chapel roof at Ravenhaven (winter, Year 5); hummed childhood tune (winter, Year 6); broke faith with Lubin, promised work never begun (winter, Year 6); quit Mireford (winter, Year 7); pressed jade ledger into wife of Ribin (winter, Year 7); married Jovus Haskoway at Elmgate (spring, Year 8); couple lives in Elmgate; whispered Lunar secretly married Aera (summer, Year 8, unconfirmed); received bone seal from Jovus among his things (winter, Year 8); gave promise to Orrald to teach children of Larkhaven their letters (winter, Year 8); married Dazek Fellwood at Elmgate (summer, Year 34); apprenticed anew and became a cooper (summer, Year 10); couple lived in Elmgate from then on

**Children**:
1. Jolan Wexwood (eldest son): Brewer; born at Larkhaven; found work in Elmgate (autumn, Year 2); bought ribbon, regretted it (winter, Year 3); talked with Zaten (autumn, Year 4); swore to Pedan to plant orchard above Wilholt (summer, Year 5); took Ferine in marriage at Elmgate before winter was out (autumn, Year 7); couple lived in Elmgate; confided to by Vonelle about rewritten ledger (summer, Year 8); went along to live in Fenmere as well (winter, Year 8); won iron ledger from Ferine at cards fairly, kept it (autumn, Year 10)

2. Ribin Wexwood (son): Called "Old Ribin"; married Zalis Marroway; couple lives in Ravenhaven, later Wilholt, Dunton; father to Ferine; quit Ravenhaven (winter, Year 4); father to Nybin (spring, Year 6); family in Wilholt; confided to by Lubin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 6); laughed at story (autumn, Year 5); told Kabin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 7); walked long way round (spring, Year 7); talked with Vonelle (winter, Year 7); gossip claimed secretly married Pemira (winter, Year 7, unconfirmed); went to Dunton (winter, Year 7); gave promise to Zalis to plant orchard above Braegate (spring, Year 8); finished promise (spring, Year 8); wife received jade ledger from Jossa (winter, Year 7); remarked river always was up in spring in Dunton (winter, Year 10)

3. Zaten Wexwood (son): Weaver, called "Red Zaten"; born at Wilholt; keeps brass spyglass in cedar box; quit Wilholt (Chapter 2); lost brass spyglass to Dabin Wexson at cards fairly (spring, Year 2); married Ulena Velloway at Larkholt (autumn, Year 2); couple lives in Larkholt; talked of going to Braegate, stayed (autumn, Year 3); hummed childhood tune (autumn, Year 3); gave promise to Lubin to teach children of Braegate their letters (summer, Year 4); broke faith with Lubin (autumn, Year 4); sorted old letters by candlelight (autumn, Year 4); gave promise to Maric to plant orchard above Torton (summer, Year 6); broke faith with Maric (autumn, Year 7); talked with Isdette (spring, Year 8); told by Lubin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 8); walked long way round to avoid muddy square (autumn, Year 35)

4. Second son of Elrald Wexwood: Found work in Mireford (spring, Year 6); married Isdette Brackett at Salford (summer, Year 6); couple lives in Salford; received brass flute by carrier from Jora (summer, Year 8); received it safely

## The Fellwood Household
**Location**: Larkhaven (originally); Larkmere (Year 4); Wilcombe (spring, Year 5); Ravenhaven (Garald, winter, Year 10)

**Parents**:
- Garald Fellwood (father): Cooper; possesses copper comb; gave copper comb to Zamor (winter, Year 2); won copper comb from Zamor at cards fairly (spring, Year 4); found work in Larkmere (spring, Year 4); received iron ledger from Elra (autumn, Year 4); gave promise from Kara to teach children of Mirecombe (autumn, Year 4); married only daughter of Isdan Wexson at Larkmere (winter, Year 4); couple lives in Larkmere; pressed copper comb into Fenelle's hands (winter, Year 4); moved to Wilcombe (spring, Year 5); received copper comb from Fenelle (autumn, Year 5); father to Dazek (summer, Year 6); family in Wilcombe; read almanac aloud, mispronouncing saints (spring, Year 7); pressed iron ledger into wife's hands (autumn, Year 8); received jade compass by carrier from Isdette Brackett and received it safely (autumn, Year 35); sent iron ledger by carrier to Jolan Wexwood, who received it safely (summer, Year 10); left Wilcombe and settled in Ravenhaven (winter, Year 10)
- Yedette Fellwood (mother): Cooper, called "Tall Yedette"; knows Wexwood family once owed blood debt to Marroway family (Chapter 1); told Malis (Chapter 7); went to Larkmere (spring, Year 4); died of kick from cart horse at Larkmere (autumn, Year 4)

**Children**:
1. Rolde Fellwood (eldest daughter): Tanner; born at Larkholt; married Zamor Stenoway; couple lives in Larkhaven; possesses bone seal; lost bone seal to Pewyn at cards fairly (autumn, Year 1); gossip claimed secretly married Taten (Chapter 7, unconfirmed); sorted old letters by candlelight (spring, Year 4); swore to Zamor to repair chapel roof at Mireford (autumn, Year 7); never kept promise; matter abandoned (autumn, Year 8); complained of aching back (winter, Year 10); gave birth to son Felan Stenoway (winter, Year 10)

2. Vonelle Fellwood (daughter): Married Kabin Dornick at Wilholt (autumn, Year 2); went to Wilcombe (spring, Year 3); gave birth to Orten; family in Wilcombe (winter, Year 3); moved to Mirehaven (winter, Year 3); gave birth to Zazek (winter, Year 5); family in Mirehaven; told Kabin deed forged; they quarreled (winter, Year 6); quit for Mireford (winter, Year 6); walked long way round (spring, Year 7); followed Kabin to Elmgate (autumn, Year 7); swore to husband of Zalis to teach children of Mirecombe (winter, Year 7); went to Mireford (autumn, Year 8); confided to Jolan Wexwood about rewritten ledger (summer, Year 8); won amber flute from Ellia Ashmere at cards fairly (autumn, Year 35); went along to Mirecombe (summer, Year 34)

3. Fenelle Wexson (daughter): Born at Wilcombe; received brass spyglass from Dabin Wexson (autumn, Year 2); sent parcel with brass spyglass to Isdette (winter, Year 2); went to Wilcombe (spring, Year 5); received copper comb from Garald (winter, Year 4); pressed copper comb into Garald's hands (autumn, Year 5); gave birth to Dazek with Garald (summer, Year 6); family in Wilcombe; married Jossa Wexwood at Elmgate (summer, Year 34); swore to Tawyn Haskoway to repair roof of chapel at Wilcombe (summer, Year 10); went along to live in Ravenhaven as well (winter, Year 10)

## The Wexson Household
**Location**: Fenmere (originally); Larkmere (Chapter 10); Mireholt (winter, Year 3); Mirecombe (autumn, Year 4); Larkmere and Salford (later); Fenmere (Ferine/Jolan, winter, Year 8+); Ravenhaven (Pemira/Febin, winter, Year 10)

**Parents**:
- Isdan Wexson (father): Scribe; went to Fenmere (summer, Year 2); found work in Larkmere (Chapter 10); married Ellia Ashmere at Mireholt (winter, Year 3); couple lives in Mireholt; went to Mirecombe (autumn, Year 4); only daughter married Garald Fellwood at Larkmere (winter, Year 4); died of fall from mill loft at Mirecombe (winter, Year 7); buried at Mirecombe
- Thinelle Wexson (mother): Miller; quit Larkmere, took lodgings in Fenmere (summer, Year 2); died of festered wound at Fenmere (Chapter 10)

**Children**:
1. Fenelle Wexson (eldest daughter): See under Fellwood Household

2. Dabin Wexson (son): Won brass spyglass from Zaten at cards fairly (spring, Year 2); gave brass spyglass to Fenelle (autumn, Year 2); counted coins short (autumn, Year 2); wed Pemira Velloway at Larkmere (autumn, Year 3); couple lives in Larkmere; gave birth to Febin (spring, Year 7); said price of salt is scandal (spring, Year 8); left Larkmere with Pemira, settled in Salford (winter, Year 36); swore to Zaten to rebuild fallen wall at Mireford (winter, Year 36); took Wedette Brackett in marriage at Larkmere (winter, Year 10); moved from Larkmere to Ravenhaven, taking a single trunk; Wedette went along to live in Ravenhaven as well (winter, Year 10)

3. Febin Wexson (son): Son of Dabin and Pemira; born spring, Year 7; family lives in Larkmere (later Salford); counted coins twice and came up a penny short (winter, Year 10); took Wedette Brackett in marriage at Larkmere (winter, Year 10); couple lives in Larkmere from then on

## The Brackett Household
**Location**: Torton (originally); Mirecombe, Wilholt, Larkholt, Salford, Mireford, Fenmere

**Parents**:
- Eltho Brackett (father): Herbalist; knows deed to Mirecombe pastures was forged; revealed in letter to Lunar (Chapter 3, letter burned); counted coins short (Chapter 3); apprenticed anew as miller (summer, Year 2); talked with Isdette (summer, Year 2); received brass spyglass from Isdette (spring, Year 3); rumor claims he secretly married Ormira (summer, Year 3, unconfirmed); told Isdette deed forged (summer, Year 5); left Torton, settled in Salford (autumn, Year 5); died of kick from cart horse at Salford (summer, Year 6); buried at Salford
- Isdette Brackett (mother): Ferryman; born in Mireford; knows bridge toll at Wilcombe is skimmed; confided to Isbin (Chapter 3); received letter from Vesra about chest of silver beneath well (summer, Year 2, letter burned); fell asleep in chair (summer, Year 2); gave promise to teach children of Larkholt their letters (winter, Year 2); received parcel from Fenelle with brass spyglass (winter, Year 2); pressed brass spyglass into Eltho's hands (spring, Year 3); finished teaching children of Larkholt (summer, Year 4); told by Eltho deed forged (summer, Year 5); went to Salford (autumn, Year 5); married second son of Elrald Wexwood at Salford (summer, Year 6); couple lives in Salford; argued over oat sack price (summer, Year 6); received brass spyglass from Eltho's things (spring, Year 6); received jade compass from Malis (autumn, Year 7); told Malis bridge toll skimmed (spring, Year 8); talked with Zaten (spring, Year 8); sent jade compass by carrier to Garald Fellwood and he received it safely (autumn, Year 35); revealed in letter that chest of silver lies buried at Wilcombe (autumn, Year 35, letter burned by Nezek)

**Children**:
1. Lunar Brackett (eldest son): Scribe; born in Mirehaven; married Vesra Ashmere; couple lived in Torton; received letter from Eltho about forged deed (Chapter 3, letter burned); found work in Mirecombe (summer, Year 2); rode out of Mirecombe; by next market day in Wilholt (winter, Year 2); told Yedette's youngest daughter deed forged (spring, Year 3); won brass flute from Voena at cards fairly (autumn, Year 3); pressed brass flute into Voena's hands (Chapter 11); rode out of Wilholt with Vesra; by next market day in Larkholt (summer, Year 5); couple lives in Larkholt; told by Vesra about rewritten ledger (summer, Year 8); complained of aching back (summer, Year 8); rumor claims he secretly married Aera (summer, Year 8, unconfirmed); quit Larkholt for good, took lodgings in Mireford (spring, Year 33); gave promise to Ordette to carry sealed letter to Larkhaven (summer, Year 34); Vesra followed him to Mireford within the month (spring, Year 33); fathered Aevie Brackett with Vesra (autumn, Year 10); family lives in Mireford; mended torn sleeve by window and said little (autumn, Year 10); talked with Vesra of nothing much—weather, harvest, lame horse (autumn, Year 10)

2. Ormira Brackett (daughter): Miller, called "Red Ormira"; born in Ravenhaven; quit Torton (autumn, Year 2); wed Dabin Haskoway at Braegate (autumn, Year 3); couple lived in Braegate; found work in Wilcombe (spring, Year 4); Dabin followed her; gave birth to Tawyn with Dabin; family in Wilcombe (spring, Year 7); swore to Dabin to repair chapel roof at Torton (spring, Year 7); talked of going to Mirecombe, stayed (spring, Year 7); broke faith with Dabin (summer, Year 7); won copper comb from Garald at cards fairly and kept it (winter, Year 8); rumor claims she secretly married Eltho (summer, Year 3, unconfirmed); told by Vesra that deed forged (autumn, Year 10); gave birth to son Vesdan Haskoway with Dabin; family in Mireford (winter, Year 10)

3. Isbin Brackett (son): Mason; born in Salford; confided to by Isdette about bridge toll skimming (Chapter 3); married Elra Ashmere at Mireholt (spring, Year 2); couple lives in Mireholt; father to Ordette (spring, Year 4); father to Wedette (winter, Year 4); confided to by Molan about bridge toll (autumn, Year 4); revealed in letter to Colis about bridge toll (autumn, Year 6, letter burned); told youngest daughter of Pemor about bridge toll (winter, Year 8)

## The Stenoway Household
**Location**: Larkhaven (originally); Salford (winter, Year 3); Mirehaven (summer, Year 7); Elmgate (winter, Year 7)

**Parents**:
- Orrald Stenoway (father): Scribe; left Larkhaven, settled in Salford (winter, Year 3); Maric swore to plant orchard above Dunton (winter, Year 4); received silver ring from Pewyn (autumn, Year 6); Pewyn rode out of Salford; by next market day in Mirehaven (summer, Year 7); followed her (summer, Year 7); swore to Pewyn to repair chapel roof at Torton (winter, Year 7); went to Elmgate (winter, Year 7); received silver ring by carrier and received it safely (winter, Year 8); Pewyn swore to him to rebuild fallen wall at Dunton (autumn, Year 8); agreed price of salt is scandal (summer, Year 34); watched clouds and predicted rain, wrongly (summer, Year 10); died of old age at Elmgate, laid in churchyard quietly in sleep (autumn, Year 10)
- Pewyn Stenoway (mother): Brewer; won bone seal from Rolde at cards fairly (autumn, Year 1); argued over oat sack price (autumn, Year 2); counted coins short (autumn, Year 2); sent parcel with bone seal to Pemira (spring, Year 3); followed Orrald to Salford (winter, Year 3); won silver ring from Maric at cards fairly (winter, Year 4); gave silver ring to Orrald (autumn, Year 6); rode out of Salford; by next market day in Mirehaven (summer, Year 7); pressed silver ring into Orrald's hands (winter, Year 7); moved to Elmgate (winter, Year 7); swore to Orrald to rebuild fallen wall at Dunton (autumn, Year 8); argued with carter over oat sack price (winter, Year 8); sent silver ring by carrier to Ferine (winter, Year 8); laughed at story nobody else found funny (summer, Year 34)

**Children**:
1. Lubin Stenoway (eldest son): Married Malis Marroway; born in Mirehaven, called "Red Lubin"; alone carries knowledge of second cellar at Mirecombe abbey (Chapter 1); rode out of Larkhaven; by next market day in Elmgate (autumn, Year 2); revealed in letter to Malis about second cellar (winter, Year 3); Zaten broke faith with him (autumn, Year 4); went to Mireford (autumn, Year 4); Elrald confided to him about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 5); talked with Jossa (summer, Year 5); swore to Jossa to pay old debt owed to Stenoway family (autumn, Year 5); confided to Ribin about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 6); counted coins short (spring, Year 6); broke faith with Jossa (winter, Year 6); apprenticed anew as scribe (winter, Year 6); found work in Salford (summer, Year 7); went to Salford (summer, Year 7); told Zaten about rewritten ledger (spring, Year 8); rode out of Salford; by next market day in Dunton (summer, Year 8); Malis followed him within the month; quit Dunton for good with Malis and took lodgings in Fenmere (winter, Year 10)

2. Aera Stenoway (daughter): Weaver; married Katho Velloway, lived Larkholt; possessed jade map; found work in Braegate (winter, Year 2); wed Pedan Ashmere at Braegate (spring, Year 4); couple lives in Braegate; hummed childhood tune (spring, Year 4); went to Elmgate (spring, Year 5); received letter from Illia about forged deed (autumn, Year 6, letter burned); went to Ravenhaven (autumn, Year 7); rumor claims she secretly married Lunar (summer, Year 8, unconfirmed)

3. Zamor Stenoway (son): Married Rolde Fellwood; couple lives in Larkhaven; born at Mireholt; possesses oak bell; received copper comb from Garald (winter, Year 2); lost copper comb to Garald at cards fairly (spring, Year 4); received jade map from Aera by carrier (summer, Year 6); whispered Taten secretly married Pemira (summer, Year 8, unconfirmed); gave up idleness and took work as shepherd (winter, Year 10); fathered son Felan Stenoway with Rolde (winter, Year 10)

## Notable Secondary Characters
**Quiet Jovus**: Received bone seal from Pemira (autumn, Year 5); gave bone seal to Kara (summer, Year 6); received bone seal from Kara (summer, Year 6); died of old age at Elmgate (winter, Year 8); bone seal handed to Jossa among his things

**Aewyn Ashmere**: Daughter of Rodette and Maric; born autumn, Year 1; married Zaten Wexwood at Mireholt (winter, Year 5); took winter fever and died (following summer); buried at Mireholt

**Dazek Fellwood**: Son of Fenelle and Garald; born summer, Year 6; laughed at story; married Jossa Wexwood at Elmgate (summer, Year 34); couple lived in Elmgate; swore to Jossa to carry sealed letter to Mireholt (summer, Year 34); meant to go to Wilholt before frost but roads flooded, journey put off (summer, Year 10)

**Ferine Wexwood**: Daughter of Zalis and Ribin; born autumn, Year 2; quit Ravenhaven, took lodgings in Elmgate (summer, Year 6); married Jolan Wexwood at Elmgate (autumn, Year 7); couple lived in Elmgate; found work in Fenmere, moved there, did not return (winter, Year 8); received silver ring by carrier from Pewyn and received it safely (winter, Year 8); said price of salt is scandal (autumn, Year 8); gave silver ring to husband (winter, Year 36); won iron ledger from husband at cards fairly, kept it (autumn, Year 10); remarked river is up again in Fenmere (autumn, Year 10); Jolan said it always was in spring

**Nybin Wexwood**: Son of Zalis and Ribin; born spring, Year 6; talked with Jora (winter, Year 6); talked for weeks of going to Braegate, stayed in Wilholt (autumn, Year 35)

**Ilra Brackett**: Daughter of Vesra and Lunar; born spring, Year 6; family lives in Larkholt; burned letter revealing rewritten ledger from Lunar (spring, Year 33); left Larkholt, settled in Fenmere (spring, Year 33); confided to Taten late one night that ledger was rewritten (autumn, Year 35); argued with carter over oat sack price (autumn, Year 35); rode out of Fenmere; by next market day in Wilholt (summer, Year 34); married Zazek Dornick at Mirehaven chapel (autumn, Year 10); couple lives in Mirehaven; gave birth to son Aemor Dornick (winter, Year 10)

**Febin Wexson**: Son of Pemira and Dabin; born spring, Year 7; family lives in Larkmere (later Salford); took Wedette Brackett in marriage at Larkmere (winter, Year 10); couple lives in Larkmere from then on

**Wedette Brackett**: Daughter of Elra and Isbin; born winter, Year 4; family lives in Mireholt; revealed in letter that bridge toll at Wilcombe is skimmed (spring, Year 9); letter burned after reading; took Febin Wexson in marriage at Larkmere (winter, Year 10); went along to live in Ravenhaven as well (winter, Year 10)

**Tawyn Haskoway**: Daughter of Ormira and Dabin; born spring, Year 7; family lives in Wilcombe; married Taten Marroway at Wilholt (summer, Year 10); couple lives in Wilholt from then on

**Nezek Ashmere**: Son of Rodette and Maric; born autumn, Year 6; family lives in Salford; complained of aching back (summer, Year 8); burned letter from Isdette revealing chest of silver beneath well at Wilcombe (autumn, Year 35)

**Orten Dornick**: Son of Kabin and Vonelle; born winter, Year 3; married Voena Dornick at Mirecombe (summer, Year 7); fell asleep in chair (winter, Year 7); whispered that Kabin secretly married Thilis Haskoway (autumn, Year 10, unconfirmed); given solemn promise from Ellia Ashmere to plant orchard on slope above Fenmere (autumn, Year 10)

**Zazek Dornick**: Son of Kabin and Vonelle; born winter, Year 5; sorted old letters by candlelight (winter, Year 7); gave promise to Ordette to pay old debt owed to Wexwood family (winter, Year 8); married Ilra Brackett at Mirehaven chapel (autumn, Year 10); couple lives in Mirehaven; fathered son Aemor Dornick with Ilra (winter, Year 10)

**Ordette Brackett**: Daughter of Elra and Isbin; born spring, Year 4; found work in Mirehaven (autumn, Year 7); gave promise to Molan to carry sealed letter to Salford (winter, Year 7); quit Mirehaven, took lodgings in Mireford (winter, Year 8); revealed in letter that rewritten ledger was rewritten after flood (summer, Year 34); gave promise to Lunar to receive sealed letter from him to Larkhaven (summer, Year 34); swore to Vesra Ashmere to rebuild fallen wall at Mireholt, shook on it (autumn, Year 10)

**Veswyn Marroway**: Daughter of Jolan and Thilis; born summer, Year 10; family lives in Torton

**Aevie Brackett**: Daughter of Vesra and Lunar; born autumn, Year 10; family lives in Mireford

**Aemor Dornick**: Son of Ilra and Zazek; born winter, Year 10; family lives in Mirehaven

**Felan Stenoway**: Son of Rolde and Zamor; born winter, Year 10; family lives in Larkhaven

**Vesdan Haskoway**: Son of Ormira and Dabin; born winter, Year 10; family lives in Mireford
